name: Coalback
title: Smoldering Plateback
biography: This broad plated reptile stores riverbank heat beneath charcoal armor and releases it when startled.
weakness: Back away from the shell, then strike during its cooling pause.

skills.name: Coal Burst
skills.description: Heat escapes around the shell; the tiny inner circle is safe.

review.combat: Implemented using shared family controller; complete individual fight not replayed.
review.phase: Not applicable: normal mob has no boss enrage.
